rules.statement: A donatio mortis causa requires the presence of at least five witnesses or the formality of a notary and two witnesses, as per common law requirements.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is undoubtedly a very hard case, but I am unable, for the reasons set out above, to say that this is not a donatio mortis causa. There is no doubt in my mind upon the point. Under those circumstances such donations in the words of Voet (XXXIX. 6, 4) require the presence of at least five witnesses or the formality of a notary and two witnesses."
